facts.value: The International Office of Economics is the central contact point for all students of the department with questions about international topics. In particular, it advises students on organizing a study abroad and supervises guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

facts.value: Here, international students receive an easier start at Goethe University and in Frankfurt through a Frankfurt Buddy. Experienced students of the university offer support in navigating the campus, studies, and life in Frankfurt, while also creating opportunities for intercultural and linguistic exchange.
